descriptionChirho: The proper name Joseph (יוֹסֵף / יְהוֹסֵף), meaning 'he adds, he increases.' Refers primarily to the patriarch Joseph son of Jacob and Rachel (Gen 30:24ff), but also used metonymically for the tribe/territory of Joseph (the half-tribes of Ephraim and Manasseh) and for other individuals bearing this name throughout Scripture. All 213 occurrences across all four clusters share identical multilingual renderings: Arabic يُوسُف, German Josef, French Joseph, Spanish Yosef/Jose, Hindi योसेफ़, Korean 요셉. Prepositional prefixes (ל to/for) are inflectional, not semantic distinctions.
